text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Duramente. My gratitude for the birthday 
present the other day.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That high-functioning notepad... It seems 
like it'll be useful for jotting down 
advice for my juniors.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I would be honored if you put it to good 
use. ...There are many juniors at Tracen 
Academy who look up to you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The ideal of the 'Empress' you've held 
since childhood... It truly hasn't 
changed, has it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You remember? ...No, of course you do. 
Both you and I were students of my mother, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I still remember how, despite your young 
age, you properly guided the students at 
the academy.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Did that happen too? ...Heh, back then, I 
was still far too green compared to 
Mother.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I take pride in how much I've grown since 
childhood, but I have no intention of 
stopping my progress here.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
To become the 'ideal' for all Umamusume 
who keep on running —that is the "Empress" 
I strive to be, after all.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...That quietly burning passion. As 
expected, you haven't changed at all."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep giving you gifts on your 
birthday that will support your ideals. 
...Big Sis Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Still calling me that, huh... Good grief, 
you never change either.
